income_scope: AI-completable reward without ongoing owner labor

sources.observed: marketplace page displayed ten open bounties totaling USD 450
the largest repeated marketplace entries pointed to an upstream issue that is closed
search surfaced a USD 500 bounty, but the upstream issue is closed and labeled rewarded
the issue text reports lifecycle verification_pending, so it is not treated as newly claimable

measurement.largest_uncertainty: The public marketplace scan is not exhaustive, and listing pages can lag canonical upstream issue and claim state.

implemented.behavior: Fail closed unless reward, funding, claimability, payout terms, upstream openness, repository activity, submission path, community-PR acceptance, and absence of competing open PRs are all independently confirmed.
implemented.network_behavior: The gate consumes already-fetched snapshots and performs no external mutation or claim.

success_condition: At least one candidate passes every hard gate before implementation or claim activity.
withdrawal_condition: Reject a candidate immediately when upstream is closed, funding or payout is unverified, lifecycle is not claimable, submission is owner-only, or a competing open PR exists.
effect_window: Re-run only after a fresh marketplace candidate is found; do not spend another implementation cycle on these rejected listings.
decision: Do not implement the stale or verification-pending candidates. Continue the independent high-ticket automatic-delivery offer and demand-first product search without adding another owner action.
forecast_change: none; rejected listings are not added to pipeline
next_trigger: A newly observed reward whose marketplace and canonical upstream states both pass the fail-closed gate.
